Install libretro-fbneo on Omarchy

FinalBurn Neo (FBNeo) is a multi-system arcade emulator core packaged for RetroArch, continuing the earlier FinalBurn line of emulators. It accurately emulates classic arcade hardware including Capcom's CPS systems and Neo Geo, plus a handful of consoles, with support for netplay, rewind, and shader effects. As a libretro core it has no interface of its own — RetroArch loads it to run arcade ROMs you supply.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add libretro-fbneo-git
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1:1.0.0.02.r8581.g074bf13-1:
    pacman -Qi libretro-fbneo-git

Open and use libretro-fbneo

libretro-fbneo has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql libretro-fbneo-git | grep /usr/bin/

libretro-fbneo requirements and compatibility

  • Arcade ROM files matching the exact revisions FBNeo expects (not included and not distributed by the project)
  • RetroArch installed to load the core

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • glibc
  • libretro-core-info
  • libgcc_s.so
  • libstdc++.so
  • libz.so

Pricing and license

Free to use (custom license (see the project's license.txt), not a standard OSI license). License: LicenseRef-FBNeo.

Uninstall libretro-fbneo

omarchy pkg drop libretro-fbneo-git

Frequently asked questions

How do I install libretro-fbneo on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add libretro-fbneo-git. The download is 15 MB and it takes 49.6 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is libretro-fbneo free?

Free to use (custom license (see the project's license.txt), not a standard OSI license). The package is licensed LicenseRef-FBNeo.

How do I uninstall libretro-fbneo?

Run omarchy pkg drop libretro-fbneo-git. It removes the package from your system.

What does libretro-fbneo depend on?

The package declares 5 dependencies: glibc, libretro-core-info, libgcc_s.so, libstdc++.so, libz.so. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is libretro-fbneo a desktop app?

No. libretro-fbneo has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is libretro-fbneo in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as libretro-fbneo-git (version 1:1.0.0.02.r8581.g074bf13-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Libretro makes it. Project site: https://github.com/libretro/FBNeo. This site is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy or Omacom.
